text:
jamie (eng-platform): noticed a weird jump in endpoint-level p99 this morning, dashboard shows p99=900ms but route A is 400ms and route B is 1.1s

song (observability): were those routes sampled at the same rate? we recently changed route B sampling to 10% last week

jamie (eng-platform): good call — route A has full sampling, route B at 10%. the endpoint rollup is using t-digest merge, but counts are very different so percentiles look off

maria (frontend): UX question: should we surface a warning like "percentile stitch likely biased due to uneven sampling"? folks keep opening pager tickets

song (observability): yeah we can add a warning. long-term fix is to store per-route sample weights and do weighted merges. short-term: show a tooltip and sample counts next to each percentile

jamie (eng-platform): concrete example I dumped:
```
route A: n=12000, p99=400ms
route B: n=1200, p99=1100ms
rollup naive: p99~900ms (misleading)
weighted by origin sample: p99~430ms (closer to reality for production traffic)
```

song (observability): right. merging t-digests without serializing sample origins loses the origin distribution. we either carry sample-origin histograms or expose per-route percentiles and a composition hint

maria (frontend): exposing per-route p50/p95/p99 is doable in the UI but could clutter the card for teams with many routes. propose collapsible "by-route breakdown" and a small red badge if sample-rates differ by >5x

jamie (eng-platform): also routing policies cause dynamic shifts — e.g., fallback routing to small-capacity pool increases route B fraction. console should surface recent routing-change events tied to percentile jumps

devops-bot: reminder: rollout-2026-03-18 changed sampling for route B from 100% -> 10% at 03:12 UTC

song (observability): ok +1 to both: show per-route breakdown collapsed by default, and add a lightweight "stitch-confidence" metric. compute confidence = min(1, total_effective_samples / threshold) and show as a percent

maria (frontend): mockup incoming. do we want the tooltip text to suggest actions? e.g., "increase sampling for route B" or "switch to per-route rollup view"

jamie (eng-platform): yes actionable guidance helps. also add a link to a doc explaining why rollups can be biased when sampling differs and how to interpret p50/p95/p99 across routes

song (observability): implementation note: we can derive effective samples by reweighting sample counts by inverse sampling rate if we persist sampling_rate metadata with each metric event (small change in ingest contract)

jamie (eng-platform): that's the minimal invasiv change — add sampling_rate tag at ingest. longer-term: consider storing compact sketch per-origin so we can do exact merges across origins

maria (frontend): timeline? I can ship the collapsed UI + badge + tooltip in one sprint if backend provides per-route counts and sampling_rate tag

song (observability): I'll add sampling_rate to the event schema PR today and backfill for the last 7 days where available. I'll also add the rollup confidence computation to the metrics service

jamie (eng-platform): awesome. follow-ups: 1) PR to docs for "percentile stitch" 2) small alert rule to detect p99 delta > 2x with sample-rate skew 3) add routing-change annotation to timeline

maria (frontend): noted. will add a compact UX test in the PR description so product can review

song (observability): thanks — feel free to ping me in the thread when you have the mock so we can validate messaging

jamie (eng-platform): will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
